learning_outcomes.text: Be able to elaborate, working as a team, the graphic and written documentation necessary to realize a project.
Be able to elaborate the graphic and written documentation necessary to realize a project and defend it orally.
Be able to actively and critically search for the necessary information to carry out an engineering project.
Be able to analyze and synthesize the necessary information and apply the acquired knowledge to carry out a specific engineering project.
Evaluate and justify the technical, socioeconomic, legal, environmental, and accessibility viability of a specific engineering project.
Be able to identify and analyze the specific regulations and legislation affecting the project and apply them to it.
Be able to plan and schedule an engineering project and monitor its progress.
Differentiate professional attributions in the field of engineering.

teaching_methods: Theoretical-practical class (lectures, problem-solving, problem-based learning, cooperative learning for case studies)
Practical class (laboratory) including project-based learning, cooperative learning, case studies, and group tutoring

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment of practices (attendance, group evaluation, and ENAEE-CT4 transversal competence)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 40% for the final exam and 60% for continuous assessment, where continuous assessment comprises 10% for class exercises and 50% for group practical work. To pass the course, students must achieve a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 on both the final exam and the practical work. The practical work grade is composed of a written document (28%), an oral presentation (10%), and continuous assessment of practices including a transversal competence (12%). Most activities are recoverable in the second call; however, continuous assessment of practices (12%) and the ENAEE-CT4 competence (4% within the 12%) are not recoverable. In case of fraud on the final exam, the qualification will be 0 points, without prejudice to disciplinary proceedings.
